newsitem.title: HUNGARY: SLOW HUNGARY FX FUTURES TRADE FOCUS ON BASKET DEAL.
newsitem.headline: SLOW HUNGARY FX FUTURES TRADE FOCUS ON BASKET DEAL.

text.p: Hungary's currency futures players concentrated on basket deals on Thursday in slack trading.
All the deals on the Budapest Commodity Exchange (BCE) for mark and dollar futures were for done for the December maturity, traders said.
"Basket deals gave most part of (the BSE's) total volume," said Mihaly Otvos of OTP Forex Alkusz.
The BCE's total currency futures volume was 5,348 lots, or 720 million forints, of which mark futures accounted for 4,260 lots and dollar futures for 1011 lots.
The dollar firmed for all maturities, except the stable June, due to its rising in the main crosses on international spot currency markets, dealers said.
The greenback closed at 198.30 forints, up 80 fillers for the December maturity.
On the Budapest Stock Exchange's currency futures market the mark was the only currency which traded on Thursday, in q total turnover of 273 million forints.
It closed at 112.1 forints, down 10 fillers for the September maturity and remained steady at 129.84 for December 1998.
Hungary's forint floats against a currency basket made up 30 percent of the dollar and 70 pct of the mark.
The central bank fixed the forint at 185.63 to the dollar on Thursday.
